title: should add a variable from empty state
verifies: empty state transitions to card view when a variable is added

title: should edit an existing variable
verifies: edit form updates the variable name and value on save

title: should edit a variable and toggle secure flag
verifies: secure toggle masks the variable value with placeholder dots

title: should remove a variable with undo
verifies: delete shows undo banner and undo fully restores the variable

title: should cancel delete and keep variable intact
verifies: cancelling the remove confirmation dialog leaves the variable unchanged

title: should add a variable with secure flag enabled and display masked value
verifies: secure variable created via add form shows masked value on the card

title: should show required error when name is submitted empty
verifies: name validation shows 'Name is required' error when submitted empty

title: should show pattern error for names starting with a digit
verifies: name validation rejects names starting with a digit per /^[A-Za-z_]/ pattern

title: should show pattern error for names containing a hyphen
verifies: name validation rejects names containing hyphens

title: should show duplicate name error when adding a variable with existing name
verifies: name validation rejects duplicate variable names

title: should cancel add form and discard draft
verifies: cancelling the add form dismisses it without creating a variable

title: should cancel edit and keep variable unchanged
verifies: cancelling the edit form preserves the original variable values

title: should toggle variables panel visibility on Journey step
verifies: panel toggle button hides and shows the variables panel on the Journey step

title: should persist variables across Journey and Configure steps
verifies: variables added on Journey persist to Configure and edits reflect in both directions

title: should always show variables panel on Configure step regardless of Journey toggle
verifies: Configure step always shows the panel even when it was toggled hidden on Journey

title: should show reference syntax tooltip on info icon hover
verifies: info icon tooltip displays {{VARIABLE_NAME}} reference syntax hint

title: should let undo timer expire and permanently delete variable
verifies: undo banner auto-dismisses after 6 seconds and the variable is permanently removed

title: should only undo the most recently deleted variable
verifies: only the last deleted variable is restorable; earlier deletions are permanent

title: should show usage badge count of zero when not referenced
verifies: unreferenced variable shows '0' usage count badge

title: should update usage count when variable is referenced in a journey step
verifies: referencing {{MY_VAR}} in a step increments the usage badge count

title: should preserve draft when re-opening add form while already open
verifies: clicking pinned Add Variable button when form is open preserves the draft

title: should truncate long variable names and show full name on hover
verifies: long names are truncated on the card and full name appears in tooltip on hover
